name: salesforce-crm
description: Connect your Salesforce CRM to Claude. Search, create, and manage leads, contacts, accounts, and opportunities. Log activities, run SOQL queries, and more.
author: Emizentech

setup.instructions: No local installation required. The plugin connects to a hosted MCP server. Just install and start using Salesforce tools in Claude.
requirements: Salesforce org (Production, Sandbox, or Developer Edition)
Salesforce credentials configured on the server
